name: kautian-mirror
description: Standalone search site and browser extension for the MOE Dictionary of Frequently-Used Taiwan Taiwanese.

scripts.build: npm run build:index && npm run build:entries && npm run build:site && npm run build:ext && npm run publish:data
scripts.package:ext: npm run build && cd extension && rm -f kautian-extension.zip && zip -q kautian-extension.zip manifest.json icons/icon16.png icons/icon32.png icons/icon48.png icons/icon128.png dist/background.js dist/content.js dist/content.css data/kautian.min.json options/options.html options/options.css options/options.js && ls -la kautian-extension.zip
